title: Deploy Slop
description:
Satirical app for gathering interest in deploying vibe-coded apps and websites.

Register your interest and join the fun.
why: To poke fun at the flood of vibe-coded apps going straight to production and to give Claude design tools a test.
learned: Shipping fast. Reusing my own Cloudflare stack and boilerplate got a joke from idea to live in an evening, and reusable boilerplate is a superpower. Design itself is an AI slop which adds to the satire.
